objective: Corregir enlace en cerrado: auditar encabezado-documento e identificadores de partida mediante EXISTS, sin joins por producto ni PII.

queries.name: document_header_line_identity_variants
queries.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT vd.Sc_Cve_Sucursal, vd.Vn_Tabla, CASE WHEN ISNULL(vd.Vn_Documento_ID,'')='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS line_doc_id_empty, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Comanda c WHERE c.Co_Folio=ve.Vn_Documento) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS header_found, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Comanda_Detalle cd WHERE cd.Co_Folio=ve.Vn_Documento AND cd.Cd_Id=vd.Vn_Documento_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS head_and_doc_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Comanda_Detalle cd WHERE cd.Co_Folio=ve.Vn_Documento AND cd.Cd_Key=vd.Vn_Documento_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS head_and_doc_key, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Comanda_Detalle cd WHERE cd.Co_Folio=ve.Vn_Documento AND cd.Cd_Id=vd.Vn_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS head_and_sale_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Comanda_Detalle cd WHERE cd.Co_Folio=ve.Vn_Documento AND cd.Cd_Key=vd.Vn_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS head_and_sale_key FROM Venta vd JOIN Venta_Encabezado ve ON ve.Vn_Folio=vd.Vn_Folio WHERE vd.Sc_Cve_Sucursal IN ('0023','0021') AND vd.Vn_Fecha>=DATEADD(day,-31,CONVERT(datetime,'20261007',112))) SELECT Sc_Cve_Sucursal, Vn_Tabla,COUNT_BIG(*) AS sale_lines,SUM(header_found) AS headers_found,SUM(line_doc_id_empty) AS empty_line_document_id,SUM(head_and_doc_id) AS header_docid_matches,SUM(head_and_doc_key) AS header_dockey_matches,SUM(head_and_sale_id) AS header_saleid_matches,SUM(head_and_sale_key) AS header_salekey_matches FROM q GROUP BY Sc_Cve_Sucursal,Vn_Tabla
